description:
Write, with each run that holds a reusable verdict, a record keyed by its gate and inputs digest that names the run, so reuse can later read one record.

## Background

Runs are written by the finalizer's gate-run pass (`crates/jit/src/repository_state/mutation.rs:1052-1095`). A run is a reuse source when it executed its own checker, carries an inputs digest and passed or failed (`domain/types.rs:1020-1028`). Gate keys are lowercase-kebab and digests 64 lowercase hex, so both are safe path components. Everything under `gate-runs/` is already excluded from input digests (`repository_state/path.rs:537-560`). The gate evaluation's record attempt captures its image in a second session (`commands/gate_check.rs:944-1004`), after the digest is known.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: When a recorded run executed its checker, carries an inputs digest and passed or failed, the same redo record that writes the run writes `gate-runs/verdicts/<gate-key>/<inputs-digest>.json` naming the run's issue and run id, built by one `VirtualPath` constructor. A later such run over the same key replaces the record. The record type derives `JsonSchema`.
- [hard] REQ-02: The record attempt captures the verdict record's path, so two evaluations racing to replace one record get a retryable conflict, not a lost write.
- [hard] REQ-03: Finalizer unit tests show which runs write or replace a verdict record and which write none.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the semantic-types epic (2195c98f): issue ids are `IssueId`, gate-run ids `GateRunId`, gate keys `GateKey`, lease ids `LeaseId`, events are an `Event` envelope around a tagged `EventBody`, and record paths come from `VirtualPath` constructors. Line citations name current code, which that epic retypes.
title: Recorded runs write their per-key verdict record
